    Contains bindings to the bgfx library.

    Contains bindings to the FMOD, an end-to-end solution for adding sound and music to any game.

    Contains bindings to the GLFW library.

    org.lwjgl.nanovg - package org.lwjgl.nanovg
    Contains bindings to NanoVG, a small antialiased vector graphics rendering library for OpenGL.
    org.lwjgl.nuklear - package org.lwjgl.nuklear
    Bindings to the Nuklear library.
    org.lwjgl.odbc - package org.lwjgl.odbc
    Contains bindings to ODBC.
    org.lwjgl.openal - package org.lwjgl.openal
    Contains bindings to the OpenAL cross-platform 3D audio API.
    org.lwjgl.opencl - package org.lwjgl.opencl
    Contains bindings to the OpenCL cross-platform parallel programming API.
    org.lwjgl.opengl - package org.lwjgl.opengl
    Contains bindings to the OpenGL cross-platform 2D and 3D rendering API.
    org.lwjgl.opengles - package org.lwjgl.opengles
    Contains bindings to the OpenGL ES, a royalty-free, cross-platform API for full-function 2D and 3D graphics on embedded systems - including consoles, phones, appliances and vehicles.
    org.lwjgl.openxr - package org.lwjgl.openxr
    Contains bindings to OpenXR.
    org.lwjgl.sdl - package org.lwjgl.sdl
    Contains bindings to the Simple DirectMedia Layer, a cross-platform development library designed to provide low level access to audio, keyboard, mouse, joystick, and graphics hardware via OpenGL/Direct3D/Metal/Vulkan.
    org.lwjgl.stb - package org.lwjgl.stb
    Contains bindings to stb, a set of single-file public domain libraries.
    org.lwjgl.system - package org.lwjgl.system
    Contains implementation details and platform-specific functionality required to make LWJGL work.
    org.lwjgl.system.ffm - package org.lwjgl.system.ffm
    Experimental FFM-based binding generation at runtime.
    org.lwjgl.system.freebsd - package org.lwjgl.system.freebsd
    Contains bindings to native APIs specific to the FreeBSD operating system.

    Contains bindings to the jemalloc library.

    org.lwjgl.system.libc - package org.lwjgl.system.libc
    Contains bindings to standard C library APIs.
    org.lwjgl.system.libffi - package org.lwjgl.system.libffi

    org.lwjgl.system.linux - package org.lwjgl.system.linux
    Contains bindings to native APIs specific to the Linux operating system.
    org.lwjgl.system.linux.liburing - package org.lwjgl.system.linux.liburing
    Contains bindings to liburing.
    org.lwjgl.system.macosx - package org.lwjgl.system.macosx
    Contains bindings to native APIs specific to the macOS operating system.

    Contains bindings to the rpmalloc library.
    org.lwjgl.system.windows - package org.lwjgl.system.windows

    org.lwjgl.util.freetype - package org.lwjgl.util.freetype

    org.lwjgl.util.harfbuzz - package org.lwjgl.util.harfbuzz
    Contains bindings to the HarfBuzz, a text shaping library.
    org.lwjgl.util.hwloc - package org.lwjgl.util.hwloc
    Contains bindings to the hwloc, a portable abstraction (across OS, versions, architectures, ...) of the hierarchical topology of modern architectures, including NUMA memory nodes, sockets, shared caches, cores and simultaneous multithreading.
    org.lwjgl.util.ktx - package org.lwjgl.util.ktx
    Contains bindings to the KTX (Khronos Texture), a lightweight container for textures for OpenGL®, Vulkan® and other GPU APIs.
    org.lwjgl.util.lmdb - package org.lwjgl.util.lmdb
    Bindings to LMDB, the Symas Lightning Memory-Mapped Database.
    org.lwjgl.util.lz4 - package org.lwjgl.util.lz4
    Contains bindings to LZ4, a lossless compression algorithm, providing compression speed > 500 MB/s per core, scalable with multi-cores CPU.
    org.lwjgl.util.meshoptimizer - package org.lwjgl.util.meshoptimizer
    Contains bindings to meshoptimizer, a library that provides algorithms to help optimize meshes.
    org.lwjgl.util.msdfgen - package org.lwjgl.util.msdfgen
    Contains bindings to msdfgen, a multi-channel signed distance field generator library.

    org.lwjgl.util.opus - package org.lwjgl.util.opus
    Contains bindings to the Opus Audio Codec library.
    org.lwjgl.util.par - package org.lwjgl.util.par
    Contains bindings to the par library.
    org.lwjgl.util.remotery - package org.lwjgl.util.remotery
    Contains bindings to Remotery, a realtime CPU/GPU profiler hosted in a single C file with a viewer that runs in a web browser.
    org.lwjgl.util.renderdoc - package org.lwjgl.util.renderdoc
    Contains bindings to the RenderDoc in-application API.
    org.lwjgl.util.shaderc - package org.lwjgl.util.shaderc
    Contains bindings to Shaderc, a collection of libraries for shader compilation.
    org.lwjgl.util.spng - package org.lwjgl.util.spng
    Contains bindings to libspbg (simple png), a C library for reading and writing Portable Network Graphics (PNG) format files with a focus on security and easy of use.
    org.lwjgl.util.spvc - package org.lwjgl.util.spvc
    Contains bindings to SPIRV-Cross, a library for performing reflection on SPIR-V and disassembling SPIR-V back to high level languages.
    org.lwjgl.util.tinyexr - package org.lwjgl.util.tinyexr
    Contains bindings to the Tiny OpenEXR image library.
    org.lwjgl.util.tinyfd - package org.lwjgl.util.tinyfd
    Contains bindings to tiny file dialogs.
    org.lwjgl.util.vma - package org.lwjgl.util.vma
    Contains bindings to VMA, a simple and easy to integrate API to help you allocate memory for Vulkan® buffer and image storage.
    org.lwjgl.util.xxhash - package org.lwjgl.util.xxhash
    Contains bindings to xxHash, an extremely fast non-cryptographic hash algorithm.
    org.lwjgl.util.yoga - package org.lwjgl.util.yoga
    Contains bindings to Yoga.
    org.lwjgl.util.zstd - package org.lwjgl.util.zstd
    Contains bindings to Zstandard (zstd), a fast lossless compression algorithm, targeting real-time compression scenarios at zlib-level and better compression ratios.
    org.lwjgl.vulkan - package org.lwjgl.vulkan
    Contains bindings to Vulkan, a new generation graphics and compute API that provides high-efficiency, cross-platform access to modern GPUs used in a wide variety of devices from PCs and consoles to mobile phones and embedded platforms.
